title: Leonxlnx Taste Skill: portable anti-slop agent skills for UI layout and motion
summary: MIT-licensed agent-skills repo that upgrades AI-built interfaces on layout, typography, motion, and spacing, plus image-generation skills for reference boards. Individual SKILL.md files install in Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code; docs and examples live at tasteskill.dev.
question_it_answers: Which portable taste skills upgrade generic AI-built UIs instead of adding another component kit?
